analyze_coco_robustness: analyze COCO-style robustness evaluation results from a result file for bbox and segm tasks
evaluate_voc_robustness: evaluate Pascal VOC-style corruption benchmark results and report mean performance metrics
print_coco_results: print COCO-style evaluation metrics including AP at various IoU thresholds and area ranges
get_robustness_results: get robustness evaluation results for COCO, VOC, or Cityscapes datasets with configurable metrics
extract_distortions: extract corruption distortion names from a robustness evaluation result file
